1.explanation: This demo renders a Carbon UI Shell with a top Header and a side nav that can act as a rail (isRail=true). We provide two controls: one to enable/disable rail mode and another to expand/collapse the nav. The “Applications” submenu is set to defaultExpanded to simulate the user opening it. When you collapse the rail (click “Collapse Nav” in rail mode), the submenu stays expanded behind the scenes—showing only blank space or a stray focus/active indicator in the collapsed rail. That reproduces the whitespace and off-rail highlighting bug described in the report.
1.bug_scenario: In rail mode (when SideNav is rendered as a “rail”), expanding a submenu and then collapsing the rail leaves the submenu’s items mounted (but hidden) inside the collapsed rail. This results in extra whitespace in the rail, and if you focus or select one of those hidden submenu items, you see the active/focus state off the rail (highlight bar) with no visible content.
